expectations.buyer: E-commerce brands, retailers, and finance/logistics teams outsourcing fulfillment to 3PLs
expectations.pain: Complex rate cards and WMS activity records create storage, pick-pack, materials, accessorial, and surcharge invoice leakage
expectations.strongestIncumbent: 3PL billing modules, freight audit firms, AP automation, supply-chain finance platforms, consultants, and spreadsheet reconciliation
expectations.biggestRisk: 3PL contracts and event data may be inaccessible or non-standard, incumbents may already audit the spend, and contingency economics may fail on low recoverable value
